output_format: f=geojson&outSR=4326 (GeoJSON FeatureCollection, EPSG:4326 WGS84 lng/lat; server-side reprojection from the layer's native EPSG:2263)
authentication: none (keyless official service; no credential material of any kind is sent or stored)
generated_by: capture procedure below (urllib GET of each bounded per-BBL query; verbatim response bytes)
digest_algorithm: sha256:<hex> over the exact bytes of the stored fixture file
recorded_official_rule: LOT01-LOT06 are VERBATIM live-captured official bytes (classification 'raw'). LOT80 and LOT96 are SYNTHETIC negatives DERIVED from the raw LOT01 capture (classification 'synthetic', derived_from recorded) - the ArcGIS service does not produce a multiple-features-for-one-BBL or a null-geometry response for a real lot, so those two outcomes cannot be live-captured; they mirror the M2-T009 fixture precedent (MPG96 multiple / MPG80-88 invalid). NO 4326 geometry byte was ever derived from the authoritative 2263 fixtures.

capture_procedure.description: Re-runnable offline-independent capture. For each canonical BBL, GET the exact official_endpoint URL and write the response body verbatim to the named file. The URL is built by app.connectors.mappluto_lot_outline.build_outline_query_url (BBL only from normalize_bbl; f=geojson&outSR=4326).
steps: Then re-hash with: python -c "import hashlib,glob; [print(f, 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(open(f,'rb').read()).hexdigest()) for f in sorted(glob.glob('LOT*.geojson'))]"
capture_procedure.synthetic_derivation: LOT96 = LOT01 with features[0] duplicated under a distinct id/OBJECTID (two features, one BBL). LOT80 = LOT01 with features[0].geometry set to null. Both re-serialized compact (json.dumps separators (',',':')).

coordinate_order_note: GeoJSON coordinates are [longitude, latitude]. Verified on LOT01 (Empire State Building): first exterior vertex [-73.9867337745617, 40.7485748733075] falls in NYC lng/lat ranges (lng in [-74.3,-73.6], lat in [40.4,41.0]).
identical_empty_body_note: LOT02 (nonexistent BBL) and LOT04 (condo unit lot) return byte-identical empty FeatureCollections and therefore share one sha256 - the honest no_outline outcome is distinguished by BBL/condo classification, not by the body (same precedent as M2-T009 MPG03/MPG05).

Syntactically valid nonexistent BBL: well-formed EMPTY FeatureCollection - no_outline outcome, reason no_feature_for_bbl (never an error, never a shape).

Condo BILLING lot 1000157501 (lot 7501 in billing range 7501-7599, CondoNo 1025): the merged condominium-complex polygon - single_lot outcome with condo_billing_lot classification surfaced (merged-complex caveat).

Condo UNIT lot 1000151001 (lot 1001 in unit range 1001-6999) on the same block as billing lot 7501: EMPTY result captured live - no_outline outcome, reason condo_unit_lot_no_polygon (MapPLUTO has one record per complex under the billing lot).
Holed polygon lot 1000010010 (Governors Island): one exterior ring + interior hole rings (three-ring Polygon observed live) - single_lot outcome; proves holes transport verbatim.
TRUE MULTIPOLYGON lot 4142600001 (Queens; two shoreline-clipped exterior parts observed live) - single_lot outcome with a MultiPolygon geometry; proves the renderer must handle MultiPolygon.

SYNTHETIC negative: one feature with geometry=null - typed invalid_geometry outcome (never a 500, never a fabricated shape). Cannot be live-captured; derived from LOT01 by nulling features[0].geometry.

SYNTHETIC negative: two features (distinct OBJECTID) for one BBL - typed multiple_features REVIEW-REQUIRED outcome; geometry withheld, never a silent first-pick. Cannot be live-captured; derived from LOT01 by duplicating features[0].
